text:
maria: heads up — after the scheduled kms key rotation our nightly sdlc pipeline started failing SAST jobs. looks like the scanner can't decrypt artifacts, so a bunch of PR scans aborted. cc @oncall-sec :eyes:

jon: we rotated the key and updated bindings at 03:14 UTC. i pushed the new binding but i may have missed the scanner service account in the iam policy. investigating now.

lee: CI logs show repeated errors: `ERROR: kms.Decrypt: permission denied` then the scanner exits nonzero. snippet from job log:
```
> [runner] fetching artifact bundle...
> [kms] decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = requestor does not have permission to decrypt
> exit status 1
```

amanda: ugh — that causes a bunch of partial scan runs and noisy FP spikes. we should avoid deleting scan evidence. can we re-run scans after granting ephemeral decrypt to the scanner SA so we capture the original findings?

jon: confirmed — IAM change removed `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for `svc-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. i can re-add it but want an audit trail. here's the exact command i ran to rotate + update bindings: 
```
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=prod-llm-key --location=global --keyring=prod-kr
# then updated iam policy with new principal set
```

jon: also pulled the audit log lines (redacted):
```
protoPayload.methodName: "SetIamPolicy"
resourceName: "projects/redwood-inference/locations/global/keyRings/prod-kr/cryptoKeys/prod-llm-key"
authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "infra-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```

amanda: plan suggestion — (1) grant ephemeral decrypt to scanner SA, (2) re-run failing scan matrix, (3) capture full raw artifacts and attach to vuln ticket, (4) add a short postmortem section to the triage playbook so rotations include a scan-binding checklist.

maria: +1. can we use a temporary grant window so we don't widen blast radius? jon, can you do a time-limited binding and then we re-run?

jon: yep. i'll create a 1-hour binding using iam conditions and log it here when done. will also tag the audit entry id.

lee: for the re-run, recommend this GH Actions snippet to get reproducible evidence and upload raw bundles to the vuln tracker: 
```
- name: Decrypt artifacts for scanner
  run: |
    echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICE_KEY" > /tmp/key.json
    export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/key.json
    gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=bundle.enc --plaintext-file=bundle.tgz --location=global --keyring=prod-kr --key=prod-llm-key || true
- name: Upload raw bundle
  uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
  with:
    name: scanner-raw-bundle
    path: bundle.tgz
```

amanda: also add a tag on the vuln tickets like `sast:rotation-retry` so we can filter regressions caused by infra changes.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for rotation at 04:02 UTC per `rollback-rotation-1918000000` job. status: in_progress :wrench:

maria: perfect — once jon posts the audit entry id and time-limited binding details i'll kick off the re-runs. i'll also open a short triage doc in confluence and link here.

oncall-sec: noted, i'll keep an eye on FP counts and mute any noise alerts for the next 2 hours to avoid page storms. :white_check_mark: 

maria: follow-up actions for tracking:
- jon: post the exact iam binding command and audit entry id (due in 10m)
- lee: drop the GH Actions snippet into the scan-run template and create a quick-run job to capture artifacts (due end of day)
- amanda: add triage checklist item for key rotations + ticket tag (sast:rotation-retry)
- oncall-sec: hold noise alerts and monitor SLO metrics for scan throughput

maria: thanks all — logging this as a root cause candidate (missing scanner SA binding during key rotation). we'll add remediation steps and a short postmortem after rollback and re-runs. :memo:
